notes: Confirmed default release policy: publish three consecutive chapters at exactly 00:00 Asia/Shanghai each normal release day. A temporary extra release may contain any explicitly approved number of chapters, including a single chapter. Extra releases consume chapters early but do NOT reduce the three-chapter quota of their originally scheduled future day. After an early release, compact the remaining scheduled chapters forward in chapter-number order so every normal release day is refilled to three chapters at 00:00 where inventory permits. Example: if 82/83/84 were scheduled for Aug 30 and chapter 82 is released early, Aug 30 becomes 83/84/85, Aug 31 becomes 86/87/88, and all later scheduled chapters shift forward by one slot. Never skip or reorder chapter numbers. Repository sync remains separately gated by config.json sync_enabled and explicit audited authorization.
